symptom: ako/mxcli#1647: describe → exec of TestApp's WorkflowCommons.User_WorkflowGroup_Select and WorkflowGroup_User_Select (Studio Pro-authored, 11.14.0) rebuilt each database-source, multi-selection comboBox1 as source 'context', selection Single — mx check CE0642 'Property Caption/Entity is required' ×4 and CE0115 on the button passing $comboBox1 to a list parameter ×2; describe had printed the database source as the association mode's `DataSource:` with a NOT re-executable note for the caption
cause: The same gap as ako/mxcli#1488 seen from the read side: combobox.def.json had no database mode, so describe could not spell one and exec could not build one
file: none of its own — fixed by mendixlabs/mxcli#1583 (database mode on hasDataSource:optionsSourceDatabaseDataSource, describeComboBoxDatabaseMode), see 2026-10-23-combobox-database-mode-not-written.json
fix: Verified on the merged branch: the same drop + create rebuild of the two TestApp pages stores both combo boxes exactly as Studio Pro does (optionsSourceType 'association' leftover included) and mx check 11.14.0 is 0 errors; describe → check over all 68 TestApp pages loses its two MDL-WIDGET16 false errors
test: covered by widget_combobox_database_test.go (from #1583); mdl-examples/bug-tests/1647-combobox-database-mode.mdl reproduces the TestApp shape (multi-selection passed to a list parameter) on a fresh project
insight: **Two sessions fixed the same gap from opposite ends the same day** — this one from describe → exec of a Studio Pro project, #1583 from a hand-written script — and converged on the same mode switch (hasDataSource:<key>, which the engine had documented for exactly this and no definition used). Merging main surfaced it as conflicts in five files and a definition that auto-merged into TWO database modes with no conflict marker: re-read every file both sides touched, not only the conflicted ones. The better half won: #1583 also fixed the editorConfig else-chain lift and the hidden-property reset that kept CE0463 after the write was right, which this session's version never reached because its repro (TestApp) does not set the properties those hide. **The measurement that tells a describe gap from a write gap is the rebuild, not the in-place round trip**: in place the pluggable passthrough kept the stored combo box and the run was 'Unchanged'
